data.one_liner: Detect Google Play Services and Huawei HMS Services availability on Android devices.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that allows developers to detect the availability of Google Play Services and Huawei HMS Services API on Android devices. It can also be used to check if a device is manufactured by Huawei.
use_when: You need to check if Google Play Services are available on an Android device
You need to verify if the app is running on a Huawei device with HMS services
You are handling platform-specific service availability checks
avoid_when: You are targeting non-Android platforms exclusively
You need a complete device information and sensor suite rather than just service availability
strengths: Simple and straightforward API for checking Google and Huawei services
weaknesses: Limited functionality restricted only to service availability checks
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and use it directly on Android.
